verses.original: וְהָרָעָ֖ב כָּבֵ֥ד בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·rā·‘āḇ kā·ḇêḏ bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Now the famine was still severe in the land
verses.literalPt: A fome era gravíssima na terra.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר כִּלּוּ֙ לֶאֱכֹ֣ל אֶת־ הַשֶּׁ֔בֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵבִ֖יאוּ מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ אֲבִיהֶ֔ם שֻׁ֖בוּ שִׁבְרוּ־ לָ֥נוּ מְעַט־ אֹֽכֶל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer kil·lū le·’ĕ·ḵōl ’eṯ- haš·še·ḇer ’ă·šer hê·ḇî·’ū mim·miṣ·rā·yim way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ’ă·ḇî·hem šu·ḇū šiḇ·rū- lā·nū mə·‘aṭ- ’ō·ḵel
verses.literal: So when Jacob’s sons had eaten all . . . the grain they had brought from Egypt their father said to them Go back and buy us a little more food
verses.literalPt: Tendo eles acabado de comer o trigo que trouxeram do Egito, disse-lhes seu pai: Voltai, comprai-nos um pouco de mantimento.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר אֵלָ֛יו יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר הָעֵ֣ד הֵעִד֩ בָּ֨נוּ הָאִ֤ישׁ לֵאמֹר֙ לֹֽא־ תִרְא֣וּ פָנַ֔י בִּלְתִּ֖י אֲחִיכֶ֥ם אִתְּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw yə·hū·ḏāh lê·mōr hā·‘êḏ hê·‘iḏ bā·nū hā·’îš lê·mōr lō- ṯir·’ū p̄ā·nay bil·tî ’ă·ḥî·ḵem ’it·tə·ḵem
verses.literal: But Judah . . . replied . . . The man . . . solemnly warned . . . us You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Judá: Fortemente nos protestou o homem, dizendo: Não vereis a minha face, se vosso irmão não estiver convosco.

verses.original: אִם־ יֶשְׁךָ֛ מְשַׁלֵּ֥חַ אֶת־ אָחִ֖ינוּ אִתָּ֑נוּ נֵרְדָ֕ה וְנִשְׁבְּרָ֥ה לְךָ֖ אֹֽכֶל׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yeš·ḵā mə·šal·lê·aḥ ’eṯ- ’ā·ḥî·nū ’it·tā·nū nê·rə·ḏāh wə·niš·bə·rāh lə·ḵā ’ō·ḵel
verses.literal: If . . . you will send our brother with us we will go down and buy food for you
verses.literalPt: Se queres enviar conosco nosso irmão, desceremos e te compraremos mantimento;

verses.original: וְאִם־ אֵינְךָ֥ מְשַׁלֵּ֖חַ לֹ֣א נֵרֵ֑ד כִּֽי־ הָאִ֞ישׁ אָמַ֤ר אֵלֵ֙ינוּ֙ לֹֽא־ תִרְא֣וּ פָנַ֔י בִּלְתִּ֖י אֲחִיכֶ֥ם אִתְּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ’ê·nə·ḵā mə·šal·lê·aḥ lō nê·rêḏ kî- hā·’îš ’ā·mar ’ê·lê·nū lō- ṯir·’ū p̄ā·nay bil·tî ’ă·ḥî·ḵem ’it·tə·ḵem
verses.literal: But if you will not send him we will not go for the man told us You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you
verses.literalPt: mas, se não queres enviá-lo, não desceremos, pois o homem nos disse: Não vereis a minha face, se vosso irmão não estiver convosco.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לָמָ֥ה הֲרֵעֹתֶ֖ם לִ֑י לְהַגִּ֣יד לָאִ֔ישׁ הַע֥וֹד לָכֶ֖ם אָֽח׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yiś·rā·’êl lā·māh hă·rê·‘ō·ṯem lî lə·hag·gîḏ lā·’îš ha·‘ō·wḏ lā·ḵem ’āḥ
verses.literal: Why did you bring this trouble upon me Israel asked Why did you tell the man you had another . . . brother
verses.literalPt: Perguntou Israel: Por que me fizestes este mal, fazendo saber ao homem que tínheis outro irmão?

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֡וּ שָׁא֣וֹל שָֽׁאַל־ הָ֠אִישׁ לָ֣נוּ וּלְמֽוֹלַדְתֵּ֜נוּ לֵאמֹ֗ר הַע֨וֹד אֲבִיכֶ֥ם חַי֙ הֲיֵ֣שׁ לָכֶ֣ם אָ֔ח וַנַ֨גֶּד־ ל֔וֹ עַל־ פִּ֖י הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה הֲיָד֣וֹעַ נֵדַ֔ע כִּ֣י יֹאמַ֔ר הוֹרִ֖ידוּ אֶת־ אֲחִיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū šā·’ō·wl šā·’al- hā·’îš lā·nū ū·lə·mō·w·laḏ·tê·nū lê·mōr ha·‘ō·wḏ ’ă·ḇî·ḵem ḥay hă·yêš lā·ḵem ’āḥ wa·nag·geḏ- lō ‘al- pî had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh hă·yā·ḏō·w·a‘ nê·ḏa‘ kî yō·mar hō·w·rî·ḏū ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥî·ḵem
verses.literal: They replied The man questioned us in detail about ourselves and our family Is your father still alive Do you have . . . another brother And we answered him accordingly . . . . . . . . . How could we possibly know . . . that he would say Bring your brother here
verses.literalPt: Responderam eles: O homem perguntou particularmente por nós e pela nossa parentela, dizendo: Vive ainda vosso pai? Tendes ainda outro irmão? Respondemos-lhe segundo o teor destas palavras; podíamos, porventura, saber com certeza que ele havia de dizer: Fazei descer vosso irmão?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוּדָ֜ה אֶל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אָבִ֗יו שִׁלְחָ֥ה הַנַּ֛עַר אִתִּ֖י וְנָק֣וּמָה וְנֵלֵ֑כָה וְנִֽחְיֶה֙ וְלֹ֣א נָמ֔וּת גַּם־ אֲנַ֥חְנוּ גַם־ אַתָּ֖ה גַּם־ טַפֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hū·ḏāh ’el- yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·ḇîw šil·ḥāh han·na·‘ar ’it·tî wə·nā·qū·māh wə·nê·lê·ḵāh wə·niḥ·yeh wə·lō nā·mūṯ gam- ’ă·naḥ·nū ḡam- ’at·tāh gam- ṭap·pê·nū
verses.literal: And Judah said to his father Israel Send the boy with me and we will go at once so that we may live and not die . . . neither we . . . nor you . . . nor our children
verses.literalPt: Então, disse Judá a Israel, seu pai: Envia o moço comigo, e levantar-nos-emos e iremos; para que vivamos e não morramos, nem nós, nem tu, nem nossos filhinhos.

verses.original: אָֽנֹכִי֙ אֶֽעֶרְבֶ֔נּוּ מִיָּדִ֖י תְּבַקְשֶׁ֑נּוּ אִם־ לֹ֨א הֲבִיאֹתִ֤יו אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ וְהִצַּגְתִּ֣יו לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְחָטָ֥אתִֽי לְךָ֖ כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî ’e·‘er·ḇen·nū mî·yā·ḏî tə·ḇaq·šen·nū ’im- lō hă·ḇî·’ō·ṯîw ’ê·le·ḵā wə·hiṣ·ṣaḡ·tîw lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wə·ḥā·ṭā·ṯî lə·ḵā kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: I will guarantee his safety You may hold me personally responsible If I do not bring him back and set him before you then may I bear the guilt before you all my life . . .
verses.literalPt: Eu serei fiador dele, da minha mão o requererás: se eu to não trouxer e o não colocar diante da tua face, serei réu de crime para contigo em todo o tempo.

verses.original: כִּ֖י לוּלֵ֣א הִתְמַהְמָ֑הְנוּ כִּֽי־ עַתָּ֥ה שַׁ֖בְנוּ זֶ֥ה פַעֲמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: kî lū·lê hiṯ·mah·mā·hə·nū kî- ‘at·tāh šaḇ·nū zeh p̄a·‘ă·mā·yim
verses.literal: If we had not . . . delayed . . . we could have come and gone . . . twice by now
verses.literalPt: Se não nos tivéssemos demorado, certamente, já segunda vez teríamos estado de volta.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֜ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אֲבִיהֶ֗ם אִם־ כֵּ֣ן׀ אֵפוֹא֮ זֹ֣את עֲשׂוּ֒ קְח֞וּ מִזִּמְרַ֤ת הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ בִּכְלֵיכֶ֔ם וְהוֹרִ֥ידוּ לָאִ֖ישׁ מִנְחָ֑ה מְעַ֤ט צֳרִי֙ וּמְעַ֣ט דְּבַ֔שׁ נְכֹ֣את וָלֹ֔ט בָּטְנִ֖ים וּשְׁקֵדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·ḇî·hem ’im- kên ’ê·p̄ō·w zōṯ ‘ă·śū qə·ḥū miz·zim·raṯ hā·’ā·reṣ biḵ·lê·ḵem wə·hō·w·rî·ḏū lā·’îš min·ḥāh mə·‘aṭ ṣo·rî ū·mə·‘aṭ də·ḇaš nə·ḵōṯ wā·lōṭ bā·ṭə·nîm ū·šə·qê·ḏîm
verses.literal: Then their father Israel said to them If it must be so then do this Put some of the best products of the land in your packs and carry them down as a gift for the man a little balm and a little honey spices and myrrh pistachios and almonds
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhes Israel, seu pai: Se é assim, então, fazei isso: tomai dos melhores frutos da terra nas vossas vasilhas e levai ao homem um presente: um pouco de bálsamo, e um pouco de mel, tragacanto, e ládano, nozes de pistácia, e amêndoas.

verses.original: וְכֶ֥סֶף מִשְׁנֶ֖ה קְח֣וּ בְיֶדְכֶ֑ם וְאֶת־ הַכֶּ֜סֶף הַמּוּשָׁ֨ב בְּפִ֤י אַמְתְּחֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ תָּשִׁ֣יבוּ בְיֶדְכֶ֔ם אוּלַ֥י מִשְׁגֶּ֖ה הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵe·sep̄ miš·neh qə·ḥū ḇə·yeḏ·ḵem wə·’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ ham·mū·šāḇ bə·p̄î ’am·tə·ḥō·ṯê·ḵem tā·šî·ḇū ḇə·yeḏ·ḵem ’ū·lay miš·geh hū
verses.literal: Take double the silver with you so that you may return the silver that was put back . . . into the mouths of your sacks Perhaps it was a mistake
verses.literalPt: Levai também em vossas mãos dinheiro em dobro; o dinheiro que foi posto na boca dos vossos sacos, tornai a levá-lo em vossas mãos; bem pode ser que fosse engano.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ אֲחִיכֶ֖ם קָ֑חוּ וְק֖וּמוּ שׁ֥וּבוּ אֶל־ הָאִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ḥî·ḵem qā·ḥū wə·qū·mū šū·ḇū ’el- hā·’îš
verses.literal: Take your brother as well and return to the man at once
verses.literalPt: Levai também vosso irmão, levantai-vos e ide ter com o homem;

verses.original: וְאֵ֣ל שַׁדַּ֗י יִתֵּ֨ן לָכֶ֤ם רַחֲמִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הָאִ֔ישׁ וְשִׁלַּ֥ח לָכֶ֛ם אֶת־ אֲחִיכֶ֥ם אַחֵ֖ר וְאֶת־ בִּנְיָמִ֑ין וַאֲנִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁכֹ֖לְתִּי שָׁכָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl šad·day yit·tên lā·ḵem ra·ḥă·mîm lip̄·nê hā·’îš wə·šil·laḥ lā·ḵem ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥî·ḵem ’a·ḥêr wə·’eṯ- bin·yā·mîn wa·’ă·nî ka·’ă·šer šā·ḵō·lə·tî šā·ḵā·lə·tî
verses.literal: May God Almighty grant you mercy before the man that he may release your other brother along with Benjamin As for me if I am bereaved I am bereaved
verses.literalPt: Deus Todo-Poderoso vos dê misericórdia diante do homem, para que ele vos restitua vosso irmão Benjamim. Mas, quanto a mim, se eu ficar sem filhos, sem filhos ficarei.

verses.original: וַיִּקְח֤וּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ אֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את וּמִשְׁנֶה־ כֶּ֛סֶף לָקְח֥וּ בְיָדָ֖ם וְאֶת־ בִּנְיָמִ֑ן וַיָּקֻ֙מוּ֙ וַיֵּרְד֣וּ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיַּֽעַמְד֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י יוֹסֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·ḥū hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’eṯ- ham·min·ḥāh haz·zōṯ ū·miš·neh- ke·sep̄ lā·qə·ḥū ḇə·yā·ḏām wə·’eṯ- bin·yā·min way·yā·qu·mū way·yê·rə·ḏū miṣ·ra·yim way·ya·‘am·ḏū lip̄·nê yō·w·sêp̄
verses.literal: So the men took these gifts along with double the amount of silver . . . . . . and Benjamin as well Then they hurried down to Egypt and stood before Joseph
verses.literalPt: Tomaram, pois, os homens aquele presente, e o dinheiro em dobro, e a Benjamim; levantando-se, desceram ao Egito e apresentaram-se a José.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨רְא יוֹסֵ֣ף אִתָּם֮ אֶת־ בִּנְיָמִין֒ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לַֽאֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ בֵּית֔וֹ הָבֵ֥א אֶת־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים הַבָּ֑יְתָה וּטְבֹ֤חַ טֶ֙בַח֙ וְהָכֵ֔ן כִּ֥י אִתִּ֛י יֹאכְל֥וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים בַּֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar yō·w·sêp̄ ’it·tām ’eṯ- bin·yā·mîn way·yō·mer la·’ă·šer ‘al- bê·ṯōw hā·ḇê ’eṯ- hā·’ă·nā·šîm hab·bā·yə·ṯāh ū·ṭə·ḇō·aḥ ṭe·ḇaḥ wə·hā·ḵên kî ’it·tî yō·ḵə·lū hā·’ă·nā·šîm baṣ·ṣā·ho·rā·yim
verses.literal: When Joseph saw Benjamin with his brothers he said to the steward of his house Take these men to my house Slaughter an animal and prepare it for they shall dine . . . with me at noon
verses.literalPt: Vendo José a Benjamim com eles, disse ao despenseiro de sua casa: Conduze os homens para casa, mata reses e apronta tudo; pois eles hão de comer comigo ao meio-dia.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ הָאִ֔ישׁ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֣ר יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיָּבֵ֥א הָאִ֛ישׁ אֶת־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים בֵּ֥יתָה יוֹסֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·’îš ka·’ă·šer ’ā·mar yō·w·sêp̄ way·yā·ḇê hā·’îš ’eṯ- hā·’ă·nā·šîm bê·ṯāh yō·w·sêp̄
verses.literal: The man did as Joseph had commanded and took the brothers - to Joseph’s house
verses.literalPt: Fez o homem como José ordenara e levou os homens para a casa de José.

verses.original: וַיִּֽירְא֣וּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֗ים כִּ֣י הֽוּבְאוּ֮ בֵּ֣ית יוֹסֵף֒ וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ עַל־ דְּבַ֤ר הַכֶּ֙סֶף֙ הַשָּׁ֤ב בְּאַמְתְּחֹתֵ֙ינוּ֙ בַּתְּחִלָּ֔ה אֲנַ֖חְנוּ מֽוּבָאִ֑ים לְהִתְגֹּלֵ֤ל עָלֵ֙ינוּ֙ וּלְהִתְנַפֵּ֣ל עָלֵ֔ינוּ וְלָקַ֧חַת אֹתָ֛נוּ לַעֲבָדִ֖ים וְאֶת־ חֲמֹרֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yî·rə·’ū hā·’ă·nā·šîm kî hū·ḇə·’ū bêṯ yō·w·sêp̄ way·yō·mə·rū ‘al- də·ḇar hak·ke·sep̄ haš·šāḇ bə·’am·tə·ḥō·ṯê·nū bat·tə·ḥil·lāh ’ă·naḥ·nū mū·ḇā·’îm lə·hiṯ·gō·lêl ‘ā·lê·nū ū·lə·hiṯ·nap·pêl ‘ā·lê·nū wə·lā·qa·ḥaṯ ’ō·ṯā·nū la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm wə·’eṯ- ḥă·mō·rê·nū
verses.literal: But the brothers were frightened that they had been taken to Joseph’s house We have been brought here because of . . . the silver that was returned in our bags the first time they said They intend . . . to overpower us and take us as slaves along with our donkeys
verses.literalPt: Os homens tiveram medo, porque foram levados à casa de José; e disseram: É por causa do dinheiro que da outra vez foi reposto em nossos sacos que somos trazidos aqui, para nos assaltar, e cair sobre nós, e reduzir-nos à escravidão, tanto a nós como aos nossos jumentos.

verses.original: וַֽיִּגְּשׁוּ֙ אֶל־ הָאִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ בֵּ֣ית יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיְדַבְּר֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו פֶּ֥תַח הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gə·šū ’el- hā·’îš ’ă·šer ‘al- bêṯ yō·w·sêp̄ way·ḏab·bə·rū ’ê·lāw pe·ṯaḥ hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: So they approached Joseph’s steward - . . . and spoke to him . . . at the entrance to the house
verses.literalPt: Tendo-se chegado ao despenseiro da casa de José, disseram-lhe à porta da casa:

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִ֑י יָרֹ֥ד יָרַ֛דְנוּ בַּתְּחִלָּ֖ה לִשְׁבָּר־ אֹֽכֶל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū bî ’ă·ḏō·nî yā·rōḏ yā·raḏ·nū bat·tə·ḥil·lāh liš·bār- ’ō·ḵel
verses.literal: Please sir they said we really did come down . . . here the first time to buy food
verses.literalPt: Senhor meu, na verdade, descemos dantes a comprar mantimento;

verses.original: וַֽיְהִ֞י כִּי־ בָ֣אנוּ אֶל־ הַמָּל֗וֹן וַֽנִּפְתְּחָה֙ אֶת־ אַמְתְּחֹתֵ֔ינוּ וְהִנֵּ֤ה כֶֽסֶף־ אִישׁ֙ בְּפִ֣י אַמְתַּחְתּ֔וֹ כַּסְפֵּ֖נוּ בְּמִשְׁקָל֑וֹ וַנָּ֥שֶׁב אֹת֖וֹ בְּיָדֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kî- ḇā·nū ’el- ham·mā·lō·wn wan·nip̄·tə·ḥāh ’eṯ- ’am·tə·ḥō·ṯê·nū wə·hin·nêh ḵe·sep̄- ’îš bə·p̄î ’am·taḥ·tōw kas·pê·nū bə·miš·qā·lōw wan·nā·šeḇ ’ō·ṯōw bə·yā·ḏê·nū
verses.literal: But when we came to the place we lodged for the night we opened our sacks and, behold each of us found his silver in the mouth of his sack It was the full amount of our silver and we have brought it back with us
verses.literalPt: quando chegamos à estalagem, abrimos os nossos sacos, e eis que o dinheiro de cada um estava na boca do seu saco, nosso dinheiro por seu peso; tornamos a trazê-lo em nossas mãos.

verses.original: וְכֶ֧סֶף אַחֵ֛ר הוֹרַ֥דְנוּ בְיָדֵ֖נוּ לִשְׁבָּר־ אֹ֑כֶל לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְנוּ מִי־ שָׂ֥ם כַּסְפֵּ֖נוּ בְּאַמְתְּחֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵe·sep̄ ’a·ḥêr hō·w·raḏ·nū ḇə·yā·ḏê·nū liš·bār- ’ō·ḵel lō yā·ḏa‘·nū mî- śām kas·pê·nū bə·’am·tə·ḥō·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: We have brought additional silver with us to buy food We do not know who put our silver in our sacks
verses.literalPt: Outro dinheiro trouxemos em nossas mãos para comprarmos mantimento; não sabemos quem tenha posto o nosso dinheiro em nossos sacos.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ שָׁל֨וֹם לָכֶ֜ם אַל־ תִּירָ֗אוּ אֱלֹ֨הֵיכֶ֜ם וֵֽאלֹהֵ֤י אֲבִיכֶם֙ נָתַ֨ן לָכֶ֤ם מַטְמוֹן֙ בְּאַמְתְּחֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם כַּסְפְּכֶ֖ם בָּ֣א אֵלָ֑י וַיּוֹצֵ֥א אֲלֵהֶ֖ם אֶת־ שִׁמְעֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·lō·wm lā·ḵem ’al- tî·rā·’ū ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wê·lō·hê ’ă·ḇî·ḵem nā·ṯan lā·ḵem maṭ·mō·wn bə·’am·tə·ḥō·ṯê·ḵem kas·pə·ḵem bā ’ê·lāy way·yō·w·ṣê ’ă·lê·hem ’eṯ- šim·‘ō·wn
verses.literal: It is fine . . . said the steward Do not be afraid Your God the God of your father gave you the treasure that was in your sacks I received . . . your silver Then he brought Simeon out to them
verses.literalPt: Ele disse: Paz seja convosco, não temais; o vosso Deus e o Deus de vossos pais deu-vos um tesouro nos vossos sacos; o vosso dinheiro chegou a mim. Ele lhes trouxe fora Simeão.

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֥א הָאִ֛ישׁ אֶת־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים בֵּ֣יתָה יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיִּתֶּן־ מַ֙יִם֙ וַיִּרְחֲצ֣וּ רַגְלֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּתֵּ֥ן מִסְפּ֖וֹא לַחֲמֹֽרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇê hā·’îš ’eṯ- hā·’ă·nā·šîm bê·ṯāh yō·w·sêp̄ way·yit·ten- ma·yim way·yir·ḥă·ṣū raḡ·lê·hem way·yit·tên mis·pō·w la·ḥă·mō·rê·hem
verses.literal: And the steward took the men into Joseph’s house gave them water to wash their feet and provided food for their donkeys
verses.literalPt: Então, os conduziu para a casa de José e deu-lhes água, e eles lavaram os pés; também deu de comer aos jumentos deles.

verses.original: וַיָּכִ֙ינוּ֙ אֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֔ה עַד־ בּ֥וֹא יוֹסֵ֖ף בַּֽצָּהֳרָ֑יִם כִּ֣י שָֽׁמְע֔וּ כִּי־ שָׁ֖ם יֹ֥אכְלוּ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḵî·nū ’eṯ- ham·min·ḥāh ‘aḏ- bō·w yō·w·sêp̄ baṣ·ṣā·ho·rā·yim kî šā·mə·‘ū kî- šām yō·ḵə·lū lā·ḥem
verses.literal: Since the brothers had been told that they were going to eat a meal there they prepared their gift for Joseph’s arrival at noon
verses.literalPt: Eles prepararam o presente para quando José viesse ao meio-dia, pois ouviram que ali haviam de comer.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א יוֹסֵף֙ הַבַּ֔יְתָה וַיָּבִ֥יאּוּ ל֛וֹ אֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר־ בְּיָדָ֖ם הַבָּ֑יְתָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ־ ל֖וֹ אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō yō·w·sêp̄ hab·bay·ṯāh way·yā·ḇî’·’ū lōw ’eṯ- ham·min·ḥāh ’ă·šer- bə·yā·ḏām hab·bā·yə·ṯāh way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū- lōw ’ā·rə·ṣāh
verses.literal: When Joseph came home they presented . . . him with the gifts they had brought . . . and they bowed . . . to the ground before him
verses.literalPt: Tendo José entrado em casa, trouxeram-lhe para dentro o presente que tinham nas suas mãos e prostraram-se perante ele com o rosto em terra.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁאַ֤ל לָהֶם֙ לְשָׁל֔וֹם וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הֲשָׁל֛וֹם אֲבִיכֶ֥ם הַזָּקֵ֖ן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֑ם הַעוֹדֶ֖נּוּ חָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·’al lā·hem lə·šā·lō·wm way·yō·mer hă·šā·lō·wm ’ă·ḇî·ḵem haz·zā·qên ’ă·šer ’ă·mar·tem ha·‘ō·w·ḏen·nū ḥāy
verses.literal: He asked . . . if they were well and then he asked How is your elderly father you told me about Is he still alive
verses.literalPt: Ele lhes perguntou como estavam e disse: Vai bem vosso pai, o velho de quem me falastes? Ainda vive?

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ שָׁל֛וֹם לְעַבְדְּךָ֥ לְאָבִ֖ינוּ עוֹדֶ֣נּוּ חָ֑י וַֽיִּקְּד֖וּ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū šā·lō·wm lə·‘aḇ·də·ḵā lə·’ā·ḇî·nū ‘ō·w·ḏen·nū ḥāy way·yiq·qə·ḏū way·yiš·ta·ḥū
verses.literal: Your servant our father is well they answered He is still alive And they bowed down to honor him
verses.literalPt: Responderam eles: Vai bem o teu servo, nosso pai; ele ainda vive. E inclinaram as cabeças e prostraram-se.

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֣א עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּ֞רְא אֶת־ בִּנְיָמִ֣ין אָחִיו֮ בֶּן־ אִמּוֹ֒ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הֲזֶה֙ אֲחִיכֶ֣ם הַקָּטֹ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֵלָ֑י וַיֹּאמַ֕ר אֱלֹהִ֥ים יָחְנְךָ֖ בְּנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā ‘ê·nāw way·yar ’eṯ- bin·yā·mîn ’ā·ḥîw ben- ’im·mōw way·yō·mer hă·zeh ’ă·ḥî·ḵem haq·qā·ṭōn ’ă·šer ’ă·mar·tem ’ê·lāy way·yō·mar ’ĕ·lō·hîm yā·ḥə·nə·ḵā bə·nî
verses.literal: When Joseph looked up . . . and saw his brother Benjamin his own mother’s son he asked Is this your youngest brother the one you told me about . . . Then he declared May God be gracious to you my son
verses.literalPt: José levantou os olhos, e viu a Benjamim, seu irmão, filho de sua mãe, e perguntou: Este é o vosso irmão mais pequeno, de quem me falastes? E disse: Deus se compadeça de ti, meu filho.

verses.original: וַיְמַהֵ֣ר יוֹסֵ֗ף כִּֽי־ נִכְמְר֤וּ רַחֲמָיו֙ אֶל־ אָחִ֔יו וַיְבַקֵּ֖שׁ לִבְכּ֑וֹת וַיָּבֹ֥א הַחַ֖דְרָה וַיֵּ֥בְךְּ שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ma·hêr yō·w·sêp̄ kî- niḵ·mə·rū ra·ḥă·māw ’el- ’ā·ḥîw way·ḇaq·qêš liḇ·kō·wṯ way·yā·ḇō ha·ḥaḏ·rāh way·yê·ḇək šām·māh
verses.literal: Joseph hurried out because he was moved . . . to tears . . . for his brother and he went to a private room to weep . . .
verses.literalPt: José apressou-se, porque se lhe comoveram as entranhas por causa de seu irmão. Procurou onde chorar e, entrando na sua câmara, chorou ali.

verses.original: וַיִּרְחַ֥ץ פָּנָ֖יו וַיֵּצֵ֑א וַיִּ֨תְאַפַּ֔ק וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שִׂ֥ימוּ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·ḥaṣ pā·nāw way·yê·ṣê way·yiṯ·’ap·paq way·yō·mer śî·mū lā·ḥem
verses.literal: Then he washed his face and came back out Regaining his composure he said Serve the meal
verses.literalPt: Tendo lavado o rosto, saiu; e conteve-se e disse: Ponde a comida na mesa.

verses.original: וַיָּשִׂ֥ימוּ ל֛וֹ לְבַדּ֖וֹ וְלָהֶ֣ם לְבַדָּ֑ם וְלַמִּצְרִ֞ים הָאֹכְלִ֤ים אִתּוֹ֙ לְבַדָּ֔ם כִּי֩ לֹ֨א יוּכְל֜וּן הַמִּצְרִ֗ים לֶאֱכֹ֤ל אֶת־ הָֽעִבְרִים֙ לֶ֔חֶם כִּי־ תוֹעֵבָ֥ה הִ֖וא לְמִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śî·mū lōw lə·ḇad·dōw wə·lā·hem lə·ḇad·dām wə·lam·miṣ·rîm hā·’ō·ḵə·lîm ’it·tōw lə·ḇad·dām kî lō yū·ḵə·lūn ham·miṣ·rîm le·’ĕ·ḵōl ’eṯ- hā·‘iḇ·rîm le·ḥem kî- ṯō·w·‘ê·ḇāh hî lə·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: They separately served Joseph his brothers and the Egyptians They ate separately because the Egyptians would not eat . . . with the Hebrews since that was detestable to them
verses.literalPt: Serviram-lhe a ele à parte, e a eles também, à parte, e, à parte, aos egípcios que comiam com ele; os egípcios não podiam comer com os hebreus, porquanto é isso abominação aos egípcios.

verses.original: וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ לְפָנָ֔יו הַבְּכֹר֙ כִּבְכֹ֣רָת֔וֹ וְהַצָּעִ֖יר כִּצְעִרָת֑וֹ וַיִּתְמְה֥וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים אִ֥ישׁ אֶל־ רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šə·ḇū lə·p̄ā·nāw hab·bə·ḵōr kiḇ·ḵō·rā·ṯōw wə·haṣ·ṣā·‘îr kiṣ·‘i·rā·ṯōw way·yiṯ·mə·hū hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’îš ’el- rê·‘ê·hū
verses.literal: They were seated before Joseph in order by age . . . from the firstborn to the youngest and the men looked at one another in astonishment
verses.literalPt: Sentaram-se diante dele, o primogênito segundo a sua primogenitura, e o mais moço segundo a sua mocidade; e os homens se maravilharam entre si.

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֨א מַשְׂאֹ֜ת מֵאֵ֣ת פָּנָיו֮ אֲלֵהֶם֒ וַתֵּ֜רֶב מַשְׂאַ֧ת בִּנְיָמִ֛ן מִמַּשְׂאֹ֥ת כֻּלָּ֖ם חָמֵ֣שׁ יָד֑וֹת וַיִּשְׁתּ֥וּ וַֽיִּשְׁכְּר֖וּ עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā maś·’ōṯ mê·’êṯ pā·nāw ’ă·lê·hem wat·tê·reḇ maś·’aṯ bin·yā·min mim·maś·’ōṯ kul·lām ḥā·mêš yā·ḏō·wṯ way·yiš·tū way·yiš·kə·rū ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: When the portions . . . were served to them from Joseph’s table Benjamin’s . . . portion was five times larger than any of the others So they feasted and drank freely with Joseph
verses.literalPt: Enviou-lhes as porções que estavam diante dele; mas a porção de Benjamim era cinco vezes maior do que qualquer porção deles. Eles beberam e se regalaram com ele.
